data.name: Gunjan
data.gender_notes: Gunjan is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Gunjan in Sanskrit language is derived from the word 'Gun' which means sound and 'Jan' which means born. This name signifies the sound of creation, the birth of the universe, and the divine melody that resonates in every living being. The name Gunjan carries the meaning “Sound, Music” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gunjan usually hope their child will grow to embody sound, music and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine harmony and music of the universe.
data.etymology: Gunjan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sound, Music.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gunjan total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
